title: Sub-second and multi-second dopamine dynamics underlie variability in human time perception
title_zh: 亚秒和多秒多巴胺动力学支撑人类时间感知的变异性
abstract: Abstract Aberrant interval timing in the millisecond-to-second range is a consistent feature of neurological and neuropsychiatric disorders involving striatal dysfunction, yet its neurochemical substrates in the human brain remain poorly characterized. Striatal dopamine has long been implicated in temporal processing, but evidence from animal models and human pharmacological studies has proved difficult to reconcile, in part because endogenous dopamine dynamics in humans have been inaccessible at relevant timescales. Patients with Parkinson’s disease (n = 5, aged 62–73 years; two females) completed a temporal bisection task (300 trials), judging whether visual stimulus intervals (500–1100 ms) were closer to a learned short (500 ms) or long (1100 ms) reference. Dopamine and serotonin concentrations were measured in the caudate nucleus during awake deep brain stimulation surgery using fast-scan cyclic voltammetry. Elastic-net machine-learning models trained on in vitro voltammetry data were applied to human recordings to derive dopamine and serotonin time series at 10 Hz. We used cluster-based permutation analysis to identify stimulus-aligned time windows in which dopamine or serotonin differed between short and long judgements, and entered mean concentrations from these windows as predictors of temporal performance in trial-level hierarchical mixed-effects models. Slower steady-state dopaminergic and serotonergic tone, quantified as the mean concentration within successive multi-minute periods, was also assessed as a predictor of temporal behaviour. Finally, behavioural performance was compared with that of a non-clinical control cohort (n = 17, aged 50–66 years; seven females). Elevated phasic dopamine (625–670 ms after stimulus onset) were associated with a greater likelihood of short judgements and reduced temporal overestimation bias. This association was independent of the objective clock time, with an identical analysis yielding non-significant results for the short versus the long stimulus intervals. By contrast, tonic dopamine levels covaried with sensitivity in discriminating stimulus intervals (temporal precision). Lower tonic dopamine was associated with poorer temporal precision both within patients over the experimental session and in patients relative to healthy controls. No corresponding effects were observed for serotonin, suggesting dopamine specificity across phasic and tonic timescales. By resolving endogenous striatal dopamine with sub-second precision during conscious human behaviour, this study links temporally distinct dopaminergic dynamics to dissociable aspects of timing behaviour in Parkinson’s disease. This challenges accounts of dopamine as a single modulatory influence and situates these findings within the literature on partly separable effects of phasic and tonic dopaminergic signalling, reconciling discrepancies between human and animal evidence, and advancing understanding of the neurochemical basis of human time perception.
abstract_zh: 摘要 亚毫秒到秒范围的异常间隔时间是涉及丘脑功能障碍的神经学和神经精神疾病的一致特征，但其神经化学底物在人类大脑中仍知之甚少。多巴胺长期被认为在时间处理中起作用，但来自动物模型和人类药理学研究的证据难以调和，部分原因是人类内源性多巴胺动力学在相关时间尺度上一直无法获取。帕金森病患者（n = 5，年龄62–73岁；两名女性）完成了一个时间二分类任务（300次试验），判断视觉刺激间隔（500–1100 ms）是否更接近学习到的短参考（500 ms）或长参考（1100 ms）。在清醒深脑刺激手术期间，使用快扫循环伏安法在纹状体测量多巴胺和血清素浓度。基于体外伏安法数据的弹性网机器学习模型被应用于人类录制数据，以10 Hz的频率推导出多巴胺和血清素时间序列。我们使用基于簇的置换分析，识别出刺激对齐的时间窗口，在这些窗口中多巴胺或血清素的水平在短判断和长判断之间有显著差异，并将这些窗口的平均浓度作为预测变量，纳入试验层次混合效应模型中。此外，还评估了用于预测时间行为的多分钟周期内稳态多巴胺和血清素水平，量化为 successive multi-minute periods 的平均浓度。最后，将患者的行为表现与非临床对照组（n = 17，年龄50–66岁；七名女性）进行了比较。刺激出现后625–670 ms期间升高的相位多巴胺水平与更有可能做出短判断以及减少时间高估偏差有关。这种关联独立于客观时钟时间，相同的分析显示，与短刺激间隔相比，长刺激间隔未出现显著结果。相比之下， tonic 多巴胺水平与辨别刺激间隔的敏感性（时间精度）相关。实验会话中较低的 tonic 多巴胺与患者内部较差的时间精度以及患者相对于健康对照组的较差时间精度有关。未观察到对应的血清素效应，这表明在相位和 tonic 时间尺度上多巴胺的特异性。通过在有意识的人类行为中以亚秒精度解析丘脑内源性多巴胺，本研究将不同时间尺度的多巴胺动力学与帕金森病中可分离的时间行为方面联系起来。这挑战了多巴胺作为单一调节影响的观点，并将这些发现置于部分可分离的相位和 tonic 多巴胺信号文献中，调和了人类和动物证据之间的差异，并推进了人类时间感知神经化学基础的理解。
